in_hindi.name: Nibhriti
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Desire, Wish, Longing
in_hindi.long_meaning: Nibhriti एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nibhriti is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Nibh' meaning 'to desire' or 'to wish'. This name is associated with the longing for something deep and meaningful, often spiritual or emotional in nature. In Hindu mythology, Nibhriti is the name of a goddess who grants the desires of her devotees.
